name: pending-need
description: The slot a composer leaves for a need the catalogue cannot meet yet: one content.placeholder tile carrying the need key and kind. Replaced when the need is fulfilled (a new block, a market install).
provenPattern: Added for a composer's unmet block needs.

knowledge.purpose: Holds the place of a block, capability, connector, pattern or icon the app needs but no installed pack carries, until a generator or a marketplace install fills it
useCases: A block need the composer could not meet from installed packs
A region that waits on a capability or connector the app has not installed
antiPatterns: An empty image slot — media.image keeps its own layout with an empty or placeholder src
A need an installed block or pattern already meets — place that instead

placeholders.{{LABEL}}: placeholder.label — what will stand here (editor only)
placeholders.{{NEED}}: placeholder.need — the need key the composer recorded
placeholders.{{KIND}}: placeholder.kind — block | capability | connector | pattern | icon
